templates.name: MrBeast fast-cut energy
templates.desc: Rapid cuts, huge punchy captions, whoosh on every beat, non-stop motion.
templates.structure: Hook in <1s, then a new visual or zoom every 1.5-2.5s. Cut every breath. Biggest caption words on the payoff.

templates.name: Hormozi listicle
templates.desc: Numbered points over the talking head, yellow highlights, confident delivery, b-roll under each point.
templates.structure: Open with the claim ('If I had to start over…'). Then 3-5 numbered points; each point gets one b-roll or zoom. End with the CTA repeated verbatim.

templates.name: Top-N listicle
templates.desc: '5 things I stopped doing…' — one clean beat per item, captions carry the number.
templates.structure: Hook names the count. Each item = one sentence + a beat of air or zoom. No filler between items.

templates.name: Storytime
templates.desc: Casual, confessional. Softer captions, longer takes, feels like a friend telling you.

style.music: soft lofi or none, -18dB under voice

templates.structure: Keep sentence length natural — don't chop mid-thought. One slow zoom at the emotional turn. Let the story breathe.

templates.name: POV / reaction
templates.desc: Scenario text first ('POV: …'), then the reaction plays out under it.
templates.structure: First 1.5s: the scenario as the text hook, no dialogue. Then play the take. Zoom on the reveal.

templates.name: Dark motivation
templates.desc: Moody b-roll, one-liners as full-frame text, music-driven, no talking head.
templates.structure: Voiceover lines land on the beat of the music. Text is 1-3 words, full frame, centered. Slow pushes on b-roll.

templates.name: Before → After
templates.desc: Two acts: the problem, the cut, the transformation reveal.

style.music: build-up that drops at the reveal

templates.structure: Act 1 = the 'before' (muted, greyed feel). Hard cut + whoosh at the reveal. Act 2 = full color, fast cuts, payoff caption.

templates.name: Green-screen commentary
templates.desc: You over a related video/chart — the clip behind IS the topic.
templates.structure: Reference the thing on screen in the hook. Zoom when pointing at a detail. Keep the background clip readable.

templates.name: Unboxing / review
templates.desc: Product-forward: open, show, verdict. Pops on each reveal.
templates.structure: Hook = the verdict in one line. Each part of the product = one zoom + one sentence. End with buy/don't-buy.

templates.name: Step-by-step tutorial
templates.desc: STEP 1, 2, 3 — screen b-roll per step, captions carry the instruction.
templates.structure: Promise the outcome in the hook. Each step: caption 'STEP n' → action b-roll → one-line why. No tangents.

templates.name: Faceless narration
templates.desc: Voiceover over stock b-roll, centered captions, zero face on camera.
templates.structure: New b-roll every 2-4s, matched to the sentence. Captions centered (no talking head to avoid). Slow Ken-Burns on stills.

templates.name: Hot-take rant
templates.desc: Aggressive pace, big angry hook, zooms on every accusation, no mercy cuts.
templates.structure: Hook = the most provocative line of the take, verbatim. Cut every pause. Zoom on each charge. Land the punchline clean.
